title: 第二章 新的博九，酷
slug: 国民校草是女生全本免费-国民校草是女生最新章节列表
content_zh:
博九向来都是一个接受能力很强的人。
不过有一点，她要查清楚。
是谁在背后阴了她！
博九双眸一眯，病房的气温骤然冰到了极点。
接着她又笑了起来，嘴角勾起来的弧度是那么的完美。
就像是她这个人，充满了伪装性。
她是一个黑客，代号Z。
只要给她一台电脑，她就能办到任何你想让她办到的东西。
而这样的一个人，却重生在了一个高中生身上。
“少爷，你的衣服我全部都给你拿过来了，你要穿这一套，还是这一套？”陈晓东邀功一般的看着坐在窗边的美少年：“这两套都是纪梵希的最新款。”
博九单手一撑，从阳台上轻松的跳了下来，她的嘴里还叼着一根棒棒糖，银灰发向后有点慵懒的凌乱，那眉眼却是好看的要命，她薄唇微翘着，左手抄着裤袋，缓缓的朝着陈晓东走了过去。
那样慵懒懒的模样，就像是漫画里的恶魔执事，酷毙了！
陈晓东几乎快要看呆了，少爷现在这个样子拿出去，别说是女生了，就连男生…不，不能那么想！
这么想无疑就是在助长少爷的歪风邪气，他可没有忘记这次少爷是为什么被人揍进医院的！
要是让老板知道少爷还在妄想秦少这件事，绝对会打断少爷的腿！
“除了这两套之外有没有其他的？”博九看着眼前那无比亮丽的颜色，眉头皱了皱。
陈晓东立刻埋头，把衣服往外一扯：“我还把少爷最喜欢穿的BOY热款也带来了！”
BOY？
你确定你拿的不是廉价淘宝款？原主的审美观也真是蛮奇特的。
博九看着眼前那一堆花花绿绿，手指划开自己身上的病服纽扣，嗓音淡淡：“去把我的校服拿过来。”

“哎？少爷你不是不喜欢穿校服吗？”陈晓东瞪大了眼睛，显然有些被博九的话惊到了。
博九扫他一眼，只有两个字：“去拿。”
没有什么任何解释，语气酷到让人腿软，这真的是他们家那个暴发户少爷吗？
江市一中，历史悠久，师资雄厚，里面都是些厉害的人物，文理状元什么的，当然这其中也有那么小部分不思进取的学生，比如博九就是一个典型的代表。
比起富二代来，她更加不让人待见，因为她总是喜欢炫，开跑车入校，把自己弄的就像是一个煤老板。
虽然她家确实是开采煤矿的，但是她把她爹那一套搬进学校里来用，明显不合适。
还有她的穿着，每次都自认为很帅，其实在别人眼里就是个土渣非主流。
仔细想起来，博九并没有做过什么特别过分的事。
但这么一个存在，简直就是笑话，谁会喜欢？
只是今天，班主任看着眼前这个新鲜出炉的美少年，不确定的问了一句：＂博九？＂
＂是我，陈老师，我来消假。＂博九浅浅笑着。
这位陈老师楞了一下，才道：＂好，我知道了，你回去上课吧，以后不要再打架了，多把心思放在学习上。＂
＂好。＂
陈老师诧异的看着转身离开的少年。
喜欢国民校草是女生请大家
content_en:
Bojiu has always been a very receptive person.
But there was one thing she wanted to find out.
Who was behind her back?
Bo Jiu narrowed his eyes, and the temperature in the ward suddenly became extremely cold.
Then she laughed again, and the curve of the corners of her mouth was so perfect.
It's like she is full of pretense.
She is a hacker, codenamed Z.
Just give her a computer and she can do anything you want her to do.
But such a person was reborn in a high school student.
"Master, I have brought you all your clothes. Do you want to wear this one or this one?" Chen Xiaodong looked at the beautiful boy sitting by the window as if he wanted to take credit: "These two sets are the latest models from Givenchy."
Bo Jiu held up one hand and jumped down easily from the balcony. She still had a lollipop in her mouth. Her silver-gray hair was a little lazy and messy, but her eyebrows were very beautiful. Her thin lips were slightly raised, her left hand was holding her trouser pocket, and she slowly walked towards Chen Xiaodong.
He looks so lazy, just like the Demon Butler in the comics, so cool!
Chen Xiaodong was almost dumbfounded. The young master took it out like this, let alone a girl, even a boy... No, you can't think like that!
Thinking like this is undoubtedly encouraging the young master's evil tendencies. He has not forgotten why the young master was beaten into the hospital this time!
If the boss knew that the young master was still dreaming about Young Master Qin, he would definitely break the young master's legs!
"Besides these two sets, are there any others?" Bo Jiu frowned as he looked at the extremely bright colors in front of him.
Chen Xiaodong immediately buried his head and pulled out his clothes: "I also brought the young master's favorite BOY style!"
BOY?
Are you sure what you got is not a cheap Taobao model? The original owner's aesthetic sense is really unique.
Bo Jiu looked at the pile of colorful flowers in front of him, opened the buttons of his hospital uniform with his fingers, and said in a calm voice: "Go get my school uniform."
"Hey? Master, don't you like wearing school uniforms?" Chen Xiaodong's eyes widened, obviously a little shocked by Bo Jiu's words.
Bo Jiu glanced at him and said only two words: "Go get it."
There is no explanation, and the tone is so cool that it makes people weak in the knees. Is this really the upstart young man from their family?
Jiang City No. 1 Middle School has a long history and strong teachers. There are some powerful people in it, such as top students in arts and sciences. Of course, there are also a small number of students who are not enterprising. For example, Bo Jiu is a typical representative.
Compared to the rich second generation, she is even more disliked because she always likes to show off, drives a sports car to school, and makes herself look like a coal boss.
Although her family is indeed engaged in coal mining, it is obviously inappropriate for her to bring her father's style into the school.
And the way she dresses, she thinks she is handsome every time, but in fact, in the eyes of others, she is just rubbish and non-mainstream.
Thinking about it carefully, Bojiu didn't do anything particularly egregious.
But such an existence is simply a joke. Who would like it?
But today, the head teacher looked at the newly minted handsome boy in front of him and asked uncertainly: "Bo Jiu?"
"It's me, Teacher Chen, I'm here to clear up the holiday." Bo Jiu smiled lightly.
Teacher Chen was stunned for a moment and then said: "Okay, I understand. You can go back to class. Don't fight anymore and focus more on your studies."
"Okay."
Teacher Chen looked at the young man who turned and left in surprise.
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
